newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albania to host mediaeval music festival.
newsitem.headline: Albania to host mediaeval music festival.

text.p: Albania will host a European festival of mediaeval music next year in the southern town of Gjirokaster, an official said on Wednesday.

Roland Cene, head of the cultural centre in Gjirokaster, 230 km (145 miles) south of Tirana, said participants would come from Germany, France, Italy, Croatia, Austria, Spain and Hungary, as well as Albania itself. The festival is due to be held in the mediaeval town's 12th-century castle next May.
